entryPlan: After explicit parent lease, acquire the shared input lock if not already held by the parent on this turn.
Create one new Chrome tab at the normal base URL. Do not operate or reload older order tabs.
Click Play. In the actual area picker, fill Search an area with Narsingi and choose the matching visible Start here result.
If that exact name is unavailable, record the visible search result and try Patancheru. Do not enter coordinates, use a query-string area override, or choose an unlabeled guessed map point.

boundedScenario.action: Record the actual area name, initial rendered street, offer name, road, customer, approach distance, delivery distance and time after collection. Dismiss the visible tutorial tip before driving.
boundedScenario.evidence: Accessibility text and initial screenshot; record any mismatch as an observation, not an inferred shop or geometry defect.

boundedScenario.action: Prefer an offer with an approach no more than about 500 m and a short customer leg if one is available; use at most three ordinary Another clicks. Accept the selected offer and preserve its identity.
boundedScenario.evidence: Record every displayed offer used to make the selection. Longer available routes are valid partial attempts, not blockers.

boundedScenario.action: Open M and inspect the actual visible route before departure. Identify the next junction and intended lane. Click the actual Close map button, then verify the driving view returns without a stacked pause overlay.
boundedScenario.evidence: Record visible road names or landmarks only; save the map if it is needed to interpret a later defect.

boundedScenario.action: Drive at low speed using short W/A/D/S inputs, at most 6 s straight only with a visibly clear road. Recheck screenshots after turns. Follow the intended lane and slow near the pickup.
boundedScenario.evidence: Maintain an exact held-key duration ledger, route-distance observations, and actual road names shown by HUD.

boundedScenario.action: When a visible Hold E / ACT collection prompt appears, stop and hold E for approximately 1.4 s. Count pickup only if explicit collection feedback and Deliver state appear. Follow the customer route if lease time allows.
boundedScenario.evidence: Save original pickup success and, if reached, explicit handover/coin award evidence. Distance or an E key press alone does not count.

boundedScenario.action: If a divided road or bridge is naturally on the route, document before/during/after a low-speed legal junction turn or brief curb/barrier contact. If a large bus or truck naturally crosses the camera sightline, capture it without pursuing traffic.
boundedScenario.evidence: PT-005 median, PT-004 camera and physical curb/bridge checks remain untested unless the relevant geometry and controlled action are actually observed. Do not promote a driver error or missed turn to a route defect.

boundedScenario.action: If useful open road and boost are available, perform one short flight followed by explicit descent and observed landing; avoid flying during an intended ground median check.
boundedScenario.evidence: Record aerial beacon wording, absence of the 3D ground ribbon while airborne, and restoration after landing. Do not infer grounded state from boost alone.

boundedScenario.action: If handover occurs, capture the explicit result and allow the next offer to appear; if incomplete, capture exact stopping HUD. Pause, release all held inputs, inspect warning/error logs, save originals, and hand off or close only the new tab as directed.
boundedScenario.evidence: Report elapsed lease separately from held driving input, collections and handovers separately, and exact tab/paused state.
